sourceEvidence.title: Space RADAR Payload I&T Technical Advisor - Sr. Staff Engineer Systems
sourceEvidence.quote:
## **Description**
* BS in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math) with 14 years relevant experience, 12 years with MS, or 9 with a PhD
* Experience planning, executing, and analyzing integration and test campaigns, including near-field and compact antenna range activities for RADAR systems
* Experience integrating embedded firmware, flight software, and hardware to realize the radar system's operational modes and command/control interfaces
* No clearance required to start but must be eligible for TS/SCI clearance

* BS and/or MS in Electrical Engineering
* Space Integration and Test (I&T) experience at subsystem (e.g., RF panel, ESA, or processor), Payload, or Space Vehicle level
* Experience with ESA (Electronically Scanned Array)/Phased Array Antenna Integration, Test, and Calibration
* Experience designing and analyzing RF hardware for space-based RADAR payloads, from front-end components to beamforming and frequency conversion
* Active TS and/or SCI clearance
